# This suite

A Selenium (Java, Maven, JUnit 5) test suite for spiralmm.com, written by Suite Builder from a read of the site: every kind of page the
site has, a page object for each, and tests that open them, follow their links, check their forms without sending
them, and ask every address the site linked to again. It needs nothing of Suite Builder's to run.

## What is in it

| Where | What |
| --- | --- |
| `README.md` | How to run it, in full. |
| `src/main/java/…/pages/` | One page object per kind of page: what it shows, how to find each element, what proves it loaded. |
| `src/test/java/…/cases/` | The tests: smoke (every kind of page opens), navigation, menus, forms, the link report, and your own. |
| `stories/` | Stories to turn into tests: `new/`, then `done/` once a test covers each. |
| `KNOWN-ISSUES.md`, `AUDIT.html` | What is wrong with the site itself, found by the read, each with why it matters and the likely fix. |
| `bugs/` | Bugs: those Suite Builder filed for the site's own defects (`open/`), closed ones, and `FIXED.md`. |
| `SITE-GRAPH.md` | The site's kinds of page and the links between them; which links a test follows. |
| `crawl/` | The read of the site the suite was built from, and its pages as they were. |
| `guide/` | This guide. |

## Who looks after what

The person who runs Suite Builder rebuilds the suite when the site changes: every generated file is written
again. Your work is kept: the code you write in the places marked YOURS, files of your own, your stories and their
tests (see the guide's page on your changes). You run it, read its runs, write stories and tests, and close bugs.

## Where to start

`mvn test -Dgroups=smoke`: every kind of page opens once. Then `crew` (or `help`) in this folder: where the suite stands,
and what to do next.
